string.text: Jar of instant coffee "Taster's Choice"

A jar with enough freeze dried coffee to make 16 cups. It is cheap, tastes like swill, and is barley caffeinated but it is coffee nonetheless. For stalkers short on roubles, this stuff is what keeps them from dropping dead from exhaustion. It's also very easy to prepare, simply pour into some water and stir.

Tin of teabags "Twinings"

A tin of 4 Earl Grey teabags. A step above other tea brands, a step below the gourmet options. The box produces a faint but strong citrus like scent. You could eat the tea leaves but this is best enjoyed when steeped in rolling water.

Box of hot cocoa mix "Swiss Miss"

With marshmellows. A very sweet drink that warms one up quite well. Best used when mixed into warm water, but for the stalker on the go cold water will do just fine. Some Military stalkers like to mix this cocoa powder into their coffee to make an "army mocha". Nice!

Tin of instant matcha "Aromandise"

A box of 4 instant matcha packs, imported from France. Simply tear off the top of one of the packs, pour into water, and stir until powder is thoroughly dissolved. A very, very green drink that is good for you. The drink lacks caffeine though, so don't expect this to keep you awake.

A bag of enough tea leaves for four cups. Originating from the Carpathian mountain range in Ukraine, this special blend is made up of lavender, linden, hazel, acacia, melissa, and sunflower leaves along with thyme, oregano, salvia herbs. Is lightly caffeinated.

Jar of sbiten ingredients "Pushkinskiye"

A jar containing honey, a Bill's Brew instant coffee packet, a bag of ground ibuprofen and acetaminophen pills, a cinnamon stick, and a small, single serving sized bottle of vodka. Marketed as alcohol at times and a medical concotion at others, this jar contains enough ingredients to make two servings of the delicious and very sweet sbiten. Originating in Russia during medieval times, this drink has since then become very popular in many eastern Slavic cultures. In the Zone, a small mom and pa shop in the Russian city of Pushkinskiye Gory produces the majority of the drink here. They have included ingredients specifically tailored for stalkers, hence the painkillers. Considered a delicacy here in the Zone for it's taste, the care put into it's creation, and the scarcity of it in trader stocks.
